meta_description: Work out how much working capital your business needs from sales, receivable, inventory and payable days, and how much extra cash growth will tie up.
subtitle: Estimate the cash tied up in receivables and inventory, less what suppliers finance, from your sales and payment days, and see how much more you will need as sales grow.

How this is worked out

Receivables are sales × DSO ÷ days in the year; inventory and payables use cost of goods sold. Growth scales sales and cost of goods sold by the same percentage and keeps your day counts the same.
